title: Massachusetts broker fee paid by the party who engaged the broker
requirement: A licensed broker or salesperson may contract only with the prospective tenant or only with the landlord, and any fee may only be paid by the party who originally engaged and contracted with the broker.
coverage_conditions: Any person who, for a fee, finds dwelling accommodations for prospective tenants; that person must be a licensed real estate broker or salesperson.

coverage_quotes: No person shall engage in the business of finding dwelling accommodations for prospective tenants for a fee unless such person is a licensed broker or salesman as defined in section eighty-seven PP of chapter one hundred and twelve.

quoted_span: Any fee shall only be paid by the party, lessor or tenant who originally engaged and entered into a contract with the licensed broker or salesperson.
